sections.content:

(Advanced communication Technology )
Information Technology

Artificial Intelligence & Data Science
Dr. Jitendra Chandrakant Musale
ADMISSION PROCEDURE & ELIGIBILITY :
The admission in general will be as per the rules and regulations laid by Directorate of Technical Education, Maharashtra State, Mumbai. The eligibility will be according to the norms of DTE & University of Pune.
Admission Process for CAP :
The students can apply on line for the First Shift Courses as per the DTE notification. The choice code has been given in the Brochure of DTE Mumbai. Details of centralized admission procedure are available on the DTE website Click Here…! The Student has to apply on line as per the directives of Director Technical Education.
The Candidate should be Passed HSC or its equivalent examination with Physics and Mathematics as compulsory subjects along with one of the Chemistry or Biotechnology or Biology or Technical or Vocational subjects, and obtained at least 50% marks (at least 45% marks, in case of Backward class categories and Persons with Disability candidates belonging to Maharashtra State only) in the above subjects taken together; and obtained score in CET conducted by the Competent Authority.
The Candidate should be  Passed Diploma in Engineering and Technology and obtained at least 50% marks (at least 45% marks, in case of Backward class categories and Persons with Disability candidates belonging to Maharashtra State only)
The Candidate should be Passed B.Sc. Degree from a Recognized University as defined by UGC and obtained at least 50% marks (at least 45% marks, in case of backward class categories and Persons with Disability candidates belonging to Maharashtra State only) and passed XII standard with Mathematics as a subject.
Fees Structure for (First Year – Under Graduate) Click Here…!
Fees Structure (First Year – Post Graduate)
Fees Structure (First Year – B.Voc) All the rules about fees declared by the Government of Maharashtra – Fees Regulating Authority from time to time will be applicable to all the Students. For Reserved category Students Government rules will be followed and subject to the submission of required documents.
First Year Admission Process for Institute Level/Vacant Seat :
The candidates interested in securing admission under institute level/vacant seats, in the college should apply prescribed application form as per schedule notified by the college authorities from time to time and admission will be done strictly in accordance with rules prescribed by Directorate of Technical Education, Maharashtra State, Mumbai including eligibility criteria. In this regards please refer DTE website www.dte.org.in for eligibility and rules of college website.
The advertisement for admission against vacant seats will be published in different news-papers and also on our website – www.abmspcoerpune.org
The tuition fees for each academic year will be levied as per sanctioned by Shikshan Shulka Samiti appointed by Govt. of Maharashtra, Mumbai.
Refund of fees on cancellation of first year admission will be in accordance with rules notified by Directorate of Technical Education, Maharashtra State, Mumbai.
